name: h2-sto3g
summary: Tapered 2-qubit Hamiltonian of molecular H2 in the STO-3G basis at bond length R = 0.735 angstrom.
convention: Pauli labels read left-to-right as qubit 1, qubit 0 (qubit 0 is the rightmost character); little-endian to match the qv simulator.
source: Standard textbook parity-tapered H2/STO-3G Hamiltonian (see e.g. Kandala et al., Nature 549, 242 (2017), and the Qiskit textbook VQE chapter).
